description: Returns the floor layout of a plan (floors, rooms, walls, doors, windows, furniture in cm), the rooms derived from it (area, length × width, wet, level) for recalc_plan, and corners: the corner letters shown on the plan (room i has letters 4i..4i+3 clockwise from top-left: A B C D, E F G H…) with coordinates and side lengths, so «wall A-B of the kitchen» means the same to you and the user.
name: get_layout
title: Read floor layout
